newsitem.title: USA: Encad sees Q3 revenues higher.
newsitem.headline: Encad sees Q3 revenues higher.

text.p: ENCAD Inc Monday said its revenue in the first two months of the third quarter reached $21.3 million, 37 percent more than revenue for the entire third quarter of 1995.

In a statement, Encad said in the summer quarter, which is historically slow, it was difficult to assess the effect of the factors that enabled the company to achieve its levels of sales and profitability in the first half.

"As evidenced by the strong revenue performance in the two traditionally slowest months of the third quarter, the momentum from the new hardware and software products, the channel fill for the new outdoor printing system, the growing OEM business, and the growing installed base of printers using ENCAD's matched system of cartridges, inks, media and software more than neutralized the normal seasonality factors during the period," the company said.
ENCAD offers imaging technology to a broad range of industries through the design, development, manufacture and marketing of color inkjet printers, software, inks and media.
